subject: [PATCH 3/4] kernfs: Avoid namespace dereference in d_revalidate()

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs module to avoid dereferencing a namespace tag in the d_revalidate() function, which can lead to issues when kernfs_rename_ns() replaces the tag. Instead of comparing namespace IDs, it uses pointer equality for this non-user-visible check. The change is made because kn->ns will become a lockless read in the next commit, and marking both sides of it now ensures that the read and stores are properly synchronized.
